body:
The independent M7 audit #590 (G-01) confirmed that the Wi-Fi picker shares a detached scan whose deadline and process-group cleanup live only in that worker. Normal EmulationStation exit destroys the worker without joining it. Existing picker-close/reopen proof did not claim whole-process cleanup; its original evidence remains valid.

User direction: “Let's fix any gaps we discover before we generate a new build.”

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: disposable no-network guest, exact compiled scan worker and synthetic blocked child/descendant, then the affected installed picker/normal-exit flow. No radio or physical device is required.

Implementation: process-owned joinable worker, cancellation before spawn/in both read loops/between stages, idempotent normal-exit and atexit shutdown. Back remains prompt and reopening attaches to the existing job. Preserve D-CLOUD-133: do not route SIGTERM through normal ES teardown or change global service KillMode. Abrupt signal termination is a documented separate residual; backend commands retain their own bounds.

- [x] Exact baseline normal-exit orphan is retained with original result and bounded outer cleanup.
- [x] Candidate explicit exit, atexit fallback, cancellation and completed refresh retain original exits and prove no child/descendant or later-stage spawn survives.
- [x] Actual compiled picker Back/reopen presentation and normal exit are verified with source-bound frames/process receipts; canonical flow is updated.
- [x] Independent delta review, required source checks, pin promotion and affected assembled-image qualification are complete.

Candidate ES16dbac5211eea7e70db7394372033be2be7df829 passes required three-unit syntax checks and actual target object/link/strip plus both control-driver builds. All original compiler/container/watchdog/runner exits are0 with normal cleanup. Evidence: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-15-audit-followup-controls/, published at f13f9d98cb7f2057d28292edc808234028b1ca15. Four exact worker controls and actual baseline/candidate frontend normal-exit proof are complete. Baseline leaves two blocked children after driver0 (observer1); candidate cancellation/atexit/completed refresh and actual frontend join pass with no observer forced cleanup or survivors. The initial GUI fixture failures and2.285s host timing failure remain original. A separate candidate-only proof measures actual key send to complete byte-identical Back frame in59.060466ms, then reopening retains the same blocked group and exactly one enumeration. All final focused lifecycle/export channels0 and admission681f265c consumed. Exact-source frames/flow and originals are in docs/qa-logs/2026-10-15-wifi-normal-exit-result/. ES16dbac is published on test/qa-integration; distribution pin and proof are published at342eec66e9fc510f6defc87de1131d300d2e804c. Required syntax/compiler checks and package lint pass. Affected assembled-image qualification remains open before the next candidate. No broad Wi-Fi matrix or device test is required.

## Final scoped verification — 2026-10-15

The final installed ES16dbac completed Back/reopen/normal-SIGINT exit on both clean and retained-upgrade guests. Back full-frame upper bounds57.909324ms/57.258077ms, one enumeration and identical scan identities on reopen, stop/join1/1, original frontend/observer0, no scan survivors. All seven outer execution channels0. Physical radio and fatal-exit behavior are outside this criterion.

Published [clean result and reviewed frames](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/0ca9443280/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-15-final-engineering-result/clean/README.md) and [retained upgrade result and reviewed frames](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/0ca9443280/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-15-final-engineering-result/retained/README.md) include complete compact originals, exact source/installed hashes, and consumed receipts. Independent review found no blocker; canonical menu/flow references were updated in the same checkpoint. Historical build reporting failure remains explicit. Native-state proof and overall audit/RC closure remain under #596/#590.
title: M7.P5: Reap Wi-Fi scans when EmulationStation exits normally
